question: Who gave the slogan, " Freedom is my birth right and I shall have it!" ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bal Gangadhar Tilak**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The slogan "Freedom is my birthright and I shall have it!" was given by Bal Gangadhar Tilak, who was an Indian nationalist and a key figure in the Indian independence movement.
 
• Bal Gangadhar Tilak was also known as "Lokmanya Tilak" and was a prominent leader of the Indian National Congress.
 
• Badruddin Tyabji was an Indian lawyer and politician, who served as the third President of the Indian National Congress in 1887. He was a moderate leader and believed in peaceful negotiation with the British government.
 
• Lala Lajpat Rai was an Indian freedom fighter, who was also known as "Punjab Kesari". He was a prominent member of the Indian National Congress and played an important role in the Indian independence movement.
 
• Bipin Chandra Pal was an Indian nationalist, who was one of the "Lal-Bal-Pal" trio along with Lala Lajpat Rai and Bal Gangadhar Tilak. He was also a prominent member of the Indian National Congress and a strong advocate of Swadeshi movement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Known as Lokmanya, Bal Gangadhar Tilak was an Indian nationalist, educator, and advocate for independence.
 
• He belonged to the third group of the Lal Bal Pal trio. "The father of the Indian unrest" was how the British colonial authorities referred to him.
